responsibility: Implements the Rust backend’s special code generation for procedural macro crates. Rather than lowering ordinary Rust items, it builds GCC tree types and constant initializers that mirror the metadata ABI defined in libproc_macro_internal/proc_macro.h, gathers the crate’s derive, attribute, and bang macro functions from the compile context, emits hidden globals for attribute tables and the proc-macro array buffer, and publishes the exported entrypoint symbol that points runtime loading code at the compiled macro descriptors.
